name: Pet journal: a companion the character learns joins the account's pet journal at level 1
contract: Phase 3 of the pet battle port. A companion spell whose creature is a pet species (Siamese Cat, spell 10677,
species 7380) becomes a level-1, quality-1 battle pet in the account's journal as soon as the character learns
it. The journal starts empty for a new account.
